findings: All three sampled original trajectories show the green cap and a visible completed lift in all three camera views.
Large bright white bottle-wall regions with dark finger regions persist in the chest view after lift in all three trials, in both original JPEG and direct unfiltered RAW RGB.
A simple whole-episode median or browser-video conversion cannot explain this appearance because it already occurs in original RAW RGB. The physical optical cause remains unproven.
Sampled images do not prove absence of mesh penetration. Full GPU contacts still show thumb/palm initialization overlap1.441mm and bottle/table initialization overlap12.345mm.
